name: Uniscope Communications
summary: Perth WISP + business telecoms (AS133895); wound down ~2019, WA assets acquired by Pentanet (AS10214/AS132458).

events.details: Uniscope Communications Pty Ltd, Wangara WA.

Wound down; WA assets acquired by Pentanet; ABN cancelled 2023. Site live to Mar 2018, staff/IP assets with Pentanet by end-2019, company deregistered and site dead by 2021 - c. 2019 verified on multiple fronts.

refs.label: Last fully live retail ISP homepage 31 Mar 2018 (Wangara WA).
Pentanet's Dec 2019 wrap-up lists Uniscope's network engineer as ex-staff, consistent with a ~2019 wind-down/absorption.
Uniscope's ASN prefix is now a Pentanet resource - network assets did go to Pentanet.
